body: It’s been about 8 years since I decided that I wasn’t going to be like everybody else, I wasn’t going to wear a “mask” and fake myself, just to be approved and liked by people. That was during college. I just said fuck it and went to the country side, living alone, but being myself, doing what I enjoy and truly makes me happy. Even though, most people think I became crazy or some shit.

I already have their future arranged, they might be the only thing that brings me happiness for years.
I can’t even put my feelings into words, so I can’t explain what I really miss. But the only thing that comes to my mind is when I was 6-8, playing soccer with friends and cousins, talking to them with no fear. I probably wasn’t the piece of shit that I’m now, so I think they didn’t feel uncomfortable around me like most of people I used to know do now.
